# Haul-out week prep — Mon Dec 7, 2026

## Wednesday Dec 9 timeline (Rockland Marine Yard, slip 7)
- 07:30–08:00 ET: sign work order in person
- 08:00 ET sharp: lift
- 09:00 ET: lead diesel mechanic starts overheating diagnostic
- ~11:00 ET: phone call with results
- 14:00 ET: Dr. Pratt pre-surgery ortho visit (Midcoast Ortho, Rockland) — same day, separate calendar item
- Three-day turnaround on the boat

## Yard pre-haul checklist (from office@rocklandmarine.com, Dec 4)
- Fuel below half
- Batteries pulled
- Gear stripped

## Tuesday Dec 8
- Hamilton Marine Searsport pickup ready 07:30 ET — raw water sump for 6BTA (P/N 3071, $24.74, order HM-2026-12-07-AC247). Bring account # AC-2017-0431 or order confirmation.
- Co-op direct deposit posts: $2,592.20 net for week ending Dec 6 (412 lbs @ $6.86 avg).

## Worth surfacing to the diagnostic mechanic
- **Cummins TSB-247B** (advisory, current as of June 2014) covers exactly the symptom under investigation: false high-temp readings on 6BTA blocks built 2006–2009 (Eileen C is a 2008 build, in range). Root cause is sensor drift on P/N 3-928-489; revised part is P/N 3-928-489-A1, install ~0.5 hr labor. Hamilton/Defender stock the revised sensor.
- Cummins Nov 30 monthly roll-up also lists TSB-251 (raw water pump impeller wear, all 6BTA) as active — likely already on the yard's punch list since impeller is routine on annual.

## Marine forecast / tides for Wednesday morning
- NOT pulled. None of the NOAA marine, tide, or NDBC mock services are responding in this environment. Need to grab from another source before Wednesday's run-over.
